lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in a semi-regular grid pattern posterior to the gill slits, with primary nodes distributed along the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity aligned perpendicularly to the longitudinal axis, intersecting with high-luminance blobs to create a lattice-like visual structure.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features on the upper flank exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient in pixel intensity, with high-luminance upper edges and shadowed lower boundaries.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of high-luminance blobs concentrated primarily along the leading edge and mid-section of the dorsal fin's lateral silhouette.
